actions.body: The WAKE architecture relies on a strict separation between untrusted proposal inputs and deterministic state updates. Governance acts as the mechanical gatekeeper, ensuring that every transition is authorized by the record, not the proposer. These findings confirm that accountability is derived from the enforcement of mechanical rules over the state-update sequence, rather than persistent selfhood in the model invocations themselves.
